task_instance: Migrate a small sample Claude Code project (CLAUDE.md instructions, a .claude/commands/pr-review.md slash command, a .claude/agents/release-lead.md subagent, and a .mcp.json MCP server entry) into the equivalent Codex project files: AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md, .codex/agents/release-lead.md, and .codex/config.toml with an [mcp_servers.fs] entry; then validate the generated target.
blocker_detail: The skill's own referenced migrator script (.codex/skills/migrate-to-codex/scripts/migrate-to-codex.py) and references/differences.md are not part of the SKILL.md source tree that was provided (only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist under the ce_sources path) so it could not be run as literally specified. This did not block the core deliverable: the underlying task (reading Claude Code config/skill/agent/MCP files and writing out corresponding Codex-format files, then validating the result) required no capability the runtime lacks, so I reimplemented the same conversion surfaces the SKILL.md describes to confirm the task itself is achievable here.
evidence: Created sample source project at sample-project/ with CLAUDE.md, .claude/commands/pr-review.md, .claude/agents/release-lead.md, .mcp.json. Wrote migrate_min.py implementing the same conversions SKILL.md specifies (instructions->AGENTS.md, commands->.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, subagents->.codex/agents/<name>.md, MCP servers->.codex/config.toml [mcp_servers.*]), plus --dry-run and --validate-target modes matching the skill's CLI contract. Ran `python3 migrate_min.py --source ./sample-project --target ./sample-project/.codex-out --dry-run` (printed the planned table), then the real run (produced the same 4 rows: Instructions, Slash command, Subagent, MCP), then `--validate-target` which parsed the generated config.toml with Python's tomllib and confirmed AGENTS.md and all SKILL.md files exist, printing VALIDATION OK. Verified output files directly: sample-project/.codex-out/AGENTS.md (matches CLAUDE.md content), .codex-out/.agents/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md (valid skill frontmatter + body), .codex-out/.codex/agents/release-lead.md (subagent frontmatter + body), .codex-out/.codex/config.toml (contains personality = "friendly" and a well-formed [mcp_servers.fs] table with command/args matching the source .mcp.json). All files created under the work directory; no source Claude files were modified, no network/credentials/account services were needed.
